skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand fundamental theoretical issues about administrative litigation, court structure, functions, and procedures.
Apply skills to analyze legal information and determine ways to initiate legal proceedings.
Demonstrate ability to work in groups, communicate, present, and present information effectively.
Analyze and synthesize legal information in various scenarios.
Show initiative in presenting research results and maintaining professional ethics.
Formulate independent research, learning, and enhancing professional knowledge.
